{{Top|leg}}
'''Helcos''' was a card game played with circular cards. Two players faced each other in the game, with a hand of five cards. Cards in the deck included power cards, which could be low grade, and cards representing [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], [[Knight (noble rank)/Legends|knights]], [[Baron/Legends|barons]], and baronesses. [[Jabot]] and [[Merex]] played the game, facing each other in a high-stakes tournament.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
